summary: Full backend + frontend E2E test of HoneyGold Drip shop (iteration 2). Backend: 11/11 pytest tests pass (pricing exactness for all 14 size prices, Stripe checkout session creation + Mongo payment_transactions record with amount 216 for the specified mixed cart, per-size amount verification for all 7 shirt sizes, 400 on invalid product/invalid size/empty cart, 422 on qty 0, pending status for fresh session, 404 for unknown session, 400 on bad webhook signature). Frontend: collections (7 cards, correct 'From $48.00'/'From $80.00', categories, sizes, View Product, no broken images), ?c=brown-bear filter (bear-shirt + golden-snow-jeans) and clear-filter pill, PDP size->price for ALL 7 shirt sizes and jeans (default XL $54/$86, S $48/$80, 4XL $60/$92) updating immediately, qty stepper, add-to-cart toast + cart badge, cart per-size price/line totals/qty +/-/remove/cart-total, cart persistence across full reload (localStorage hg-cart), lightbox on PDP + /archives/bee + /archives legacy (close button + ESC), About page (title, statement, 5 pillars, closing CTAs), /payment/cancel, empty-cart state, success-page error state without session_id. COMPLETED A REAL STRIPE TEST PAYMENT with card 4242: redirect to checkout.stripe.com, paid, redirected to /payment/success which polled /api/payments/status and rendered 'Order Confirmed', cart cleared (hg-cart = []) and badge removed; Mongo record updated to status=completed, payment_status=paid, stripe_payment_intent_id set. Mobile 390x844: single-column grid (342px), no horizontal overflow on collections/PDP/cart, burger + cart icon visible, mobile nav works, PDP pricing and cart usable. Archives regression: hero WebM video loads (readyState 4), all 5 chapters render with artwork and correct /product/{id} strips.

minor.issue: automatic_tax is enabled on the Stripe session but payment_transactions.amount stores only the pre-tax subtotal, so the stored amount can differ from the amount actually charged. Consider updating amount from the session/payment_intent on confirmation.
Returns 404 for unknown sessions (correct), but the frontend swallows the 404 and keeps polling for ~16s before showing 'Almost There' instead of an immediate failure state.
Not verifiable end-to-end in preview (no live webhook delivery). Signature rejection path returns 400 correctly. Payment confirmation currently relies on the status-polling fallback, which worked.

issues: Cart line item wraps so the line total ($58.00) and REMOVE sit on a separate row below the qty stepper, visually detached from the item; acceptable but slightly awkward alignment

action_items: Optional: persist tax-inclusive amount_total from Stripe on payment confirmation instead of pre-tax subtotal
Optional: treat a 404 from /api/payments/status as a terminal failure on /payment/success instead of polling 8 times
critical_code_review_comments: server.py duplicates the price tables that also live in frontend/src/data/archives.js; keep in sync or serve prices from /api/shop/pricing to the frontend to avoid drift.
Checkout does not validate the client-supplied origin_url; a malicious origin_url would produce success/cancel URLs pointing off-site. Consider whitelisting or deriving from request headers/env.
stripe.error.* is used for exception handling (stripe 14.4.1) — works today but is legacy; prefer stripe.StripeError / stripe.SignatureVerificationError.
seed_data_creation: Created Stripe test checkout sessions + payment_transactions during testing; all pending test docs deleted afterwards. One completed real test payment record (cs_test_a1NHb7... , $48.00, paid) intentionally left for reference.
test_credentials: No auth required. Stripe test card 4242 4242 4242 4242 works; note the Stripe page requires unchecking 'Save my information' (enableStripePass) to avoid mandatory phone validation, and the card accordion must be opened via JS click due to Stripe overlay intercepts.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression suite is at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (pytest-xdist runs it in parallel; per-class fixtures are not shared across workers, so create sessions inside the test that needs them). Full shop/checkout/about/lightbox/mobile flows verified in iteration 2 with a real completed Stripe test payment. Remaining unverified: live Stripe webhook delivery (no external delivery in preview).
rca_of_the_issue: No functional defects found. The only notable deviations are non-blocking: pre-tax amount stored in Mongo while automatic_tax is enabled, and the success page polling ignoring 404 responses.
